cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Nobody received my meeting email. This office has stopped communicating. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to send it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And nobody noticed. Our entire communication system depends on my memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it. Go and have your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're covering communications while I'm absent. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich.

mechanism: A confidently takes charge of a supposed systemic problem, expanding each small fact while adapting investigative roles to keep B cooperating.
confusable: Distinguish ordinary troubleshooting from disproportionate escalation to organized recruitment or institutional failure; S02 needs accepted limits and shared roles.
comparison: Missing biscuits become organizational hunger network; unsent email becomes communication succession crisis.
seedUse: Canonical biscuits and drafts seeds establish small causes; adapt S02 method to B corrections without endorsing A grand inferences as fact.
